d: Dilli men yamuna ke kalindi kunj, okhla bairaj aur nadi ke lanbe hisson men ek bar phir jahrili saphed jhag ki moti parat dikhaee dene lagi hai. chhath ke paranprik paridhanon men mahilaen isi jhag ke bich kamar tak pani men khari hain. kinare par adhikari spre paip lekar khare hain. kaimre bhi tay samay par pahunch jate hain. ham yah sab islie jante hain, kyonki pichhle panch sal se lagatar iski riporting kar rahe hain.
